name: peloton-communicator-monorepo
description: Peloton Communicator - Cross-platform push-to-talk communication system

scripts.setup: npm run setup:tools && npm run setup:mobile && npm run setup:server
scripts.dev:server: cd packages/server && air || go run main.go
scripts.test: npm run test:mobile && npm run test:server
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:mobile:coverage && npm run test:server:coverage
scripts.lint: npm run lint:mobile && npm run lint:server
scripts.lint:mobile: cd packages/mobile && dart analyze && dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
scripts.format: npm run format:mobile && npm run format:server
scripts.build: npm run build:mobile && npm run build:server
scripts.build:mobile: cd packages/mobile && flutter build apk --release && flutter build ios --release --no-codesign
scripts.clean: npm run clean:mobile && npm run clean:server && npm run clean:root
scripts.docs: npm run docs:generate && npm run docs:serve
scripts.docs:generate: npm run docs:api && npm run docs:mobile
scripts.docs:api: cd packages/server && swag init -g main.go --output docs/swagger || echo 'Swagger generation skipped'
scripts.docs:mobile: cd packages/mobile && dart doc || echo 'Dart doc generation skipped'
scripts.security: npm run security:mobile && npm run security:server
scripts.security:mobile: cd packages/mobile && flutter pub deps --json | jq '.packages[] | select(.source == "hosted")' | grep -E 'version|name'
scripts.security:server: cd packages/server && govulncheck ./... || echo 'Install govulncheck: go install golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@latest'
scripts.deps:check: npm run deps:check:mobile && npm run deps:check:server
scripts.deps:update: npm run deps:update:mobile && npm run deps:update:server
scripts.deps:update:server: cd packages/server && go get -u ./... && go mod tidy
scripts.precommit: npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.postinstall: npm run setup:mobile && npm run setup:server

author: Peloton Communicator Team
